next.reason: 2023 restates the rule: 'the procedures associated with a USE statement are executed after completion of the standard input-output exception routine upon the unsuccessful execution of an input-output operation unless an AT END or INVALID KEY phrase takes precedence', with the same file-name-1, OUTPUT and EXTEND cases and the same exclusion of files named by file-name-1 in another USE (§2023:14.9.49.4 GR6). The exception-checking PERFORM preamble cannot apply to a 1985 program; INVALID KEY and the INPUT/I-O cases do not reach report files, which open only OUTPUT or EXTEND. Same effect.
